1170-1645-5334-5954-8345.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4050-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.

78-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
78-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Steel Leaf Paladin by paying its mana cost.
When Steel Leaf Paladin enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1263-4699-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4699-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

34-147-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-5686.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3188-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3188-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4200-5998-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

206-215-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-3755-4927-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-4927-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

618-4456-5645-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Stenn.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

6797-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
6797-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-2921-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2292-5220-6539-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

431-4365-4772-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4365-4772-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

339-677-4927-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
997-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

4699-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
4699-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

4681-6132-6798.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

224-1772-3756-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

813-3306-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Slip On the Ring.
813-3306-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

618-1734-2292.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1069-1232-2079-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-2079-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1090-2034-3605-4871-5006.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a card using Lurrus this turn.
1090-2034-3605-4871-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Restoration Angel, adding {C}{C}.
When Restoration Angel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it returns Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Repeat.

618-1039.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Teardrop Kami with haste.
Activate the Teardrop Kami token by sacrificing it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

730-1479-3257.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

273-1003-4763-5147.description:
Equip Phyrexian Walker with Shuko.
Sacrifice Phyrexian Walker to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to you hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker.
Repeat.

2034-2382-4853-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Mimic Vat.
2034-2382-4853-5149.description:
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Ashnod's Altar, generating two generic mana.
Imprint Mimic Vat with Dross Scorpion.
Activate Mimic Vat for 1 mana, creating a token copy of Dross Scorpion.
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Ashnod's Altar, and target Mimic Vat with its death trigger.

2556-3395-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

738-1778-1969-2034.description:
Sacrifice Memnite to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Memnite to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
